Grok Imagine Video is now ranked #1 on the AI video leaderboard.

The latest Grok Imagine Video 1.5 preview model took the top spot ahead of ByteDance's Dreamina and Kling.

What makes this even more impressive is the ranking was achieved with just 5,564 votes while competing against models that have been evaluated tens of thousands of times.

xAI is moving fast.

From text to images to video generation, Grok is quickly becoming a serious contender across the entire AI stack.
